_what: The list .github/workflows/visual-checks.yml reads. EVERY top-level scripts/verify/*.mjs runs in CI unless it is named in one of the four exclusion lists below, so a new check is covered the day it lands and leaving one out is a visible, reasoned line here. See scripts/verify/README.md, 'CI: the checks on every pull request'.
_runners: GitHub-hosted runner images the checks run on. The FIRST one is the verdict: its results are the PR comment and the pass/fail. Any others run the same shards for comparison only. Linux, because on 2026-09-27 the Windows runner drew SwiftShader at 0.16 frames a second and took 298 s to load the city (Linux: 0.2-0.4, 50-99 s), and Linux reproduced the laptop's exact pixel numbers (tower-check).
_run: Per-script settings for scripts that DO run. args may use {out}, which becomes that script's artifact folder. est_s is the runtime measured on a GitHub runner; it only balances the shards. timeout_s is the kill ceiling.
_quarantine: Checks that do NOT run in CI, each with the reason. Broken on main itself, or cannot work without a GPU. Fix the check (or main), then delete its line here.

_tools: Not checks: no path to a non-zero exit (they photograph or print), or they need inputs only a human supplies (two checkouts, a PNG, a plan file). Running them proves nothing.
